title: 第111章 南暝禁锢第110章 离火之境
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
火浪翻涌，岩浆腾空。
凌渊一剑劈出，金红色的火刃带着离火之境的天地之威，横斩向黑袍教主。所过之处，空气被烧得扭曲爆裂，火河中的岩浆被剑气牵引，化作一道火龙卷紧随其后，声势骇人。
黑袍教主轻笑一声，袖袍轻挥。
无数漆黑的花骨朵从他周身凭空浮现，花瓣层层叠叠绽开，每一片都裹着浓稠的寂念。花群迎上火刃，没有轰鸣爆响，只有细密的滋滋声——金红火刃被黑花层层包裹，像投入深海的星火，锋芒飞速消解，最终连同火龙卷一起，被邪花吞噬得一干二净。
“烬莲火确实霸道。”黑袍教主缓步踏空，苍白的脸上笑意不变，“可惜啊，你的火，还太嫩。”
他指尖一捻，一朵黑花在指尖旋转。花瓣边缘泛着诡异的暗红，竟是吞噬了离火之力后，邪花本身也在进化。这便是归寂教最阴毒之处：不硬抗力量，而是以寂念为底、邪花为媒，吞噬同化一切攻伐之力，反哺自身。
“封吟，左翼护法交给你。姝橦，右翼。”凌渊声音冷冽，断剑在掌心旋转半圈，“他由我来。”
两道身影同时应声而出。
封吟白衣飘飞，花剑化作漫天莹白花瓣，直扑左侧黑袍护法。那护法周身寂念翻涌，双爪凝着灰黑利爪，一爪拍出，爪风所过之处连火晶地面都被腐蚀出深坑。可花瓣沾到爪风，非但不枯败，反而顺着寂念之力反向蔓延，顺着对方的经脉往里钻。
“葬花脉的小丫头，也敢在我面前放肆！”护法怒喝一声，周身爆发出浓重灰雾。可封吟身法如鬼魅，在雾中穿梭自如，每一剑都精准点在邪力运转的节点上。她本就专克邪花一脉，这护法的寂念功法，刚好撞在她的刀口上。
另一侧，姝橦的战斗更为诡异。
右侧护法刚祭出一柄寂念骨刀，眼前便骤然一花。他明明劈中了对方的身影，刀刃却穿过虚影，砍在了空处。下一秒，后背传来刺骨寒意，一道空间裂缝凭空浮现，差点将他腰斩。
“空间法则？”护法又惊又怒，骨刀舞得密不透风。可姝橦根本不与他正面碰撞，身形在层层叠叠的空间夹层中穿梭，时而在左，时而在右，每一次现身都留下一道致命的空间斩。不过十余招，那护法身上便添了数道深可见骨的伤口，寂念之力顺着伤口疯狂外泄。
主战场中，凌渊与黑袍教主的交锋，已到了白热化。
“烬莲·千重焰。”
凌渊断剑急挥，上千道细密火刃同时成型，像一场金色的暴雨，铺天盖地罩向对方。每一道火刃都凝聚到了极致，不扩散半分威力，专破单点防御。
黑袍教主眼神微凝，终于收起了几分轻慢。他双手结印，周身黑花疯狂生长，瞬间化作一道厚实的花墙。火刃撞在花墙上，第一层花瓣瞬间汽化，第二层、第三层接连崩碎，可黑花生生不息，碎一层长一层，硬生生将千重焰挡在了三尺之外。
“有点意思。”黑袍教主舔了舔下唇，眼中闪过狂热，“龙帝火种在你手里，倒是没被糟蹋。不过——”
他猛地一掌拍在自己胸口。
一口漆黑的精血喷出，落在黑花之上。所有花瓣同时亮起暗红光泽，花墙骤然向内收缩，反卷而上，竟将千重焰尽数包裹、炼化。下一秒，黑花暴涨数倍，化作一张巨大的花网，反向凌渊当头罩下。

花网之上，寂念与离火之力交织，两种截然相反的力量诡异融合，威力比单纯的邪花强了数倍。
凌渊眸光一沉。
对方竟能在这么短的时间内，同化他的离火之力，反过来对付他。
“离火·归源。”
凌渊不闪不避，断剑插在身前火晶地面上。他双手结印，眉心龙纹隐现，丹田内的烬莲火种疯狂旋转。漫天火网落下的瞬间，他周身骤然爆发出一股强大的吸力——那是本源火种对离散火焰的召唤之力。
花网中被同化的离火之力瞬间躁动起来，竟要挣脱寂念束缚，回归本源。黑花剧烈震颤，网身寸寸开裂。
“给我破！”
凌渊一声低喝，右手握剑向上猛撩。一道巨大的金色火柱冲天而起，硬生生将花网撕成两半。火柱余势不减，直扑黑袍教主面门。
黑袍教主侧身避开，火柱擦着他的肩甲掠过，烧焦了一片黑袍。他低头看了眼破损的衣袖，脸上的笑容淡了几分。
“看来不用点真本事，还真拿不下你。”
他抬手，遥遥指向高台顶端的本源火种。
“你以为，我要的是这簇火种？”
凌渊心头一动，暗叫不好。可已经晚了。
黑袍教主指尖弹起一滴漆黑精血，精准打在本源火种之上。那滴精血像一颗石子投入火中，非但没被焚烧，反而顺着火种的纹路飞速渗透。原本金红透亮的本源火种，瞬间浮现出大片黑纹，跳动得愈发剧烈。
嗡——
整座离火之境剧烈震颤。
火河倒卷，岩浆腾空，天空中漂浮的火莲纷纷坠落。高台之下的火晶地面，一道道古老的青铜色纹路从深处浮现，纹路纵横交错，组成一座无比繁复的巨阵。阵纹沿着高台盘旋而下，最终在地面汇聚成一扇巨大的、刻满玄奥符文的青铜门扉。
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
门楣正中，两个古字缓缓亮起：
南暝。

一股远比寂玄帅更古老、更沉郁的恐怖气息，从门后泄露出来。那气息不是外放的凶戾，而是一种深入骨髓的、带着王权般的死寂，仿佛门后沉睡着一位统治了万古黑夜的君王。
content_en:
Waves of fire surged, and magma soared into the sky.
Ling Yuan slashed out with his sword, and the golden-red fire blade carried the power of heaven and earth from the Lihuo Realm and slashed horizontally at the black-robed leader. Wherever it passed, the air was twisted and exploded, and the magma in the river of fire was pulled by the sword energy, turning into a fire tornado that followed closely behind, with terrifying momentum.
The black-robed leader chuckled and waved his sleeves.
Countless dark flower bones appeared out of thin air around him, and the petals bloomed in layers, each one wrapped in thick thoughts of silence. The flowers faced the fire blade, there was no roar or explosion, only a fine sizzling sound - the golden and red fire blade was wrapped in layers of black flowers, like a spark thrown into the deep sea, the edge quickly dissipated, and finally, together with the fire tornado, it was swallowed up by the evil flowers.
"The Ember Lotus Fire is indeed domineering." The black-robed leader stepped slowly into the air, the smile on his pale face unchanged, "It's a pity that your fire is still too young."
He twisted his fingertips, and a black flower spun on his fingertips. The edge of the petals glowed with a strange dark red color. It turned out that after swallowing the power of Li Huo, the evil flower itself was also evolving. This is the most sinister aspect of the Guiji Sect: it does not resist force, but uses the thought of Jiji as its base and evil flowers as its mediator, swallowing up and assimilating all offensive forces, and feeding back on itself.
"Feng Yin, the left wing protector is left to you. Shu Cuo, the right wing." Ling Yuan's voice was cold, and the broken sword spun half a circle in his palm, "I will take care of him."
Two figures appeared at the same time.
Feng Yin's white clothes were flying, and his foil sword turned into white petals all over the sky, heading towards the black-robed protector on the left. Silent thoughts surged around the protector's body, and his claws were condensed with gray-black sharp claws. He struck out with one claw, and even the fire crystal ground was corroded into deep pits wherever the claw wind passed. But when the petals are exposed to the claw wind, not only do they not wither, but they spread in reverse direction along with the power of silent thoughts, drilling into the opponent's meridians.
"How dare you act so arrogantly in front of me, the little girl who buried the flower veins!" The protector shouted angrily, and thick gray mist erupted around her body. Ke Fengyin's movement is like a ghost, moving freely through the fog, and every sword strike is accurately targeted at the node where the evil power circulates. She specializes in conquering the evil flower lineage, and this Dharma Protector's Quiet Mind Technique hit her right on the edge of the knife.
On the other side, Shuluo's battle was even more bizarre.
As soon as the protector on the right took out a Silent Thought Bone Knife, his eyes suddenly flashed with flowers. He clearly hit the opponent's figure, but the blade passed through the shadow and struck the empty space. The next second, a biting chill came down his back, and a space crack appeared out of thin air, almost cutting him in half.
"Law of space?" The protector was shocked and angry, and the bone knife danced like an airtight seal. But Shuluo didn't collide with him head-on at all. She shuttled through the layers of space, sometimes on the left, sometimes on the right, leaving a fatal space slash every time she appeared. In just ten moves, the protector received several wounds that were deep enough to see the bones, and the power of Silent Thought crazily leaked out along the wounds.
In the main battlefield, the confrontation between Ling Yuan and the black-robed leader has reached a fever pitch.
"Ember Lotus Thousand Flames."
Ling Yuan's broken sword swung rapidly, and thousands of fine fire blades formed simultaneously, like a golden rainstorm, overwhelmingly covering the opponent. Each fire blade is condensed to the extreme, not spreading even half of its power, and is designed to break through single-point defenses.
The black-robed leader's eyes narrowed slightly, and he finally put away some of his arrogance. He formed a seal with his hands, and black flowers grew wildly around him, instantly turning into a thick wall of flowers. The fire blade hit the flower wall, and the first layer of petals vaporized instantly, and the second and third layers collapsed one after another. However, the black peanuts continued to grow, and the broken layers grew one layer at a time, blocking Qianzhongyan three feet away.
"It's interesting." The black-robed leader licked his lower lip, with enthusiasm flashing in his eyes, "The Dragon Emperor's fire is in your hands, but it hasn't been wasted. But -"
He slapped his chest suddenly.
A jet of black blood spurted out and landed on the black flower. All the petals glowed dark red at the same time, and the flower wall suddenly shrank inward and rolled upwards, wrapping and refining all the thousands of layers of flames. In the next second, the black flower expanded several times and turned into a huge flower net, which was hooded by Ling Yuan.
Above the flower net, the power of silence and fireIntertwined, the strange fusion of two completely opposite forces is several times more powerful than a simple evil flower.
Ling Yuan's eyes darkened.
The other party was able to assimilate his Lihuo power in such a short period of time and use it against him.
"Leave the fire and return to the source."
Ling Yuan did not dodge, and stuck the broken sword on the fiery crystal ground in front of him. He formed a seal with his hands, the dragon pattern loomed between his eyebrows, and the embers of lotus fire in his dantian rotated crazily. The moment the sky-wide fire net fell, a powerful suction force suddenly erupted from his body - it was the power of the original fire to summon the discrete flames.
The power of Lihuo that was assimilated in the flower net instantly became restless, trying to break free from the shackles of the thought of silence and return to its origin. The black flower trembled violently, and the net cracked inch by inch.
"Break it for me!"
Ling Yuan shouted low, holding the sword in his right hand and raising it fiercely. A huge golden pillar of fire rose into the sky and tore the flower net in half. The pillar of fire continued unabated and rushed directly to the black-robed leader's door.
The black-robed leader stepped aside, and the pillar of fire passed over his shoulder armor, scorching a piece of the black robe. He looked down at the torn sleeves, and the smile on his face faded a bit.
"It seems that I really can't defeat you without some real skills."
He raised his hand and pointed at the source of fire at the top of the high platform.
"Do you think it's this fire that I want?"
Ling Yuan's heart moved and he secretly cried out. But it's too late.
The black-robed leader flicked a drop of jet-black blood essence from his fingertips and hit it accurately on the original fire. That drop of essence and blood was like a stone thrown into the fire. Instead of being burned, it quickly penetrated along the lines of the fire. The original fire, which was originally golden and red, suddenly showed large black lines and beat more violently.
Buzz——
The entire Lihuo Realm trembled violently.
The river of fire rolled back, the magma soared into the sky, and the fire lotuses floating in the sky fell one after another. On the fire crystal ground under the high platform, ancient bronze lines emerged from the depths. The lines criss-crossed to form an extremely complex formation. The array patterns spiraled down along the high platform, and finally converged on the ground into a huge bronze door engraved with mysterious runes.

In the middle of the door lintel, two ancient characters slowly lit up:
Nan Ming.
A terrifying aura that was far older and more profound than that of Ji Xuanshuai leaked out from behind the door. The aura was not an outward ferocity, but a kind of deathly silence that went deep into the bones and carried the power of a king, as if sleeping behind the door was a king who had ruled the eternal night.
